metadata.description: Parallel threads: MRR analysis (A) vs seat utilization patterns (B)

turns.content: I need to analyze two metrics today. First, MRR trends by plan tier. Second, seat utilization by account size. Start with MRR analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge both threads and start with MRR

turns.content: For MRR, use plan.monthly_price * subscription.quantity as the calculation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use this formula for MRR

turns.content: Thread B — show me seat utilization (active users / purchased seats) by account size.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate utilization by account size

turns.content: For utilization, active user means logged in within the last 30 days.
Is there a relationship? Do accounts with low utilization also have stagnant MRR?
Thread A — which tier has the highest MRR growth rate?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate and rank MRR growth by tier

turns.content: Thread B — do accounts with low utilization have higher churn risk?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze utilization vs churn

turns.content: Earlier in Thread A we looked at MRR growth. What was the Enterprise tier growth rate?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Enterprise MRR growth rate

turns.content: Apply the same MRR formula to show me expansion MRR.
Apply the same utilization definition to show me utilization by industry.
Exclude trial accounts from both analyses.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial tier

turns.content: Both threads — is there an optimal utilization range that correlates with MRR growth?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should find optimal utilization range

turns.content: What filters are active for thread A?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: monthly_price * quantity, exclude trial

turns.content: Final synthesis — summarize MRR vs utilization findings.
What was the MRR formula we established?
What filters are active for thread B?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: 30-day activity, exclude trial

persistedCorrections.description: Use this formula for MRR (Thread A)

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Active user = logged in within last 30 days
Exclude trial accounts from both analyses
